procedure: Compiled preview, normal Workspace to Memory navigation, titles enabled. Waited for layout completion before 600 rotating/zooming frames with moving-pointer picking. Other user applications stayed running. No local builds or tests ran during measurement.
interpretation: The 50k render run meets the 33 ms frame-p95, 4 ms maximum picking and 100 ms maximum main-thread load/layout task bounds. No main-thread task at or above 50 ms was observed after Memory opened. The separate long-animation-frame diagnostic did observe a 105.8 ms frame during loading, including a 38.4 ms script; it is retained below. Earlier whole-application startup peaked at a 170 ms task.
